name: volume-low
useCase: Indicate a low audio volume level beside a volume control.
misuse: Do not use this low-volume symbol for muted audio.

16.reason: The centered speaker retains the family’s 45-degree cone edges; a quarter-pixel outward shift leaves 1px before its single wave.

24.reason: The larger centered speaker and single wave retain their 45-degree cone edges and at least 1.5px of space.
